pending: Not authorized. It opens with configs/round8-candidate.json, on Max's word, and whoever opens it records that word here. Max, 12 November 2026, 15:12 UTC: "We should have some Ben boards, but those can come in the arena."

This lane is the first measurement of Gen 8 against BEN. The candidate reads BEN's plays at half weight (`opponent_play_weight` 0.5) from trick 1: Gen 7's exponent carried over, tuned on nothing. Gen 7.1 reads BEN from about trick 7 at the same exponent, so the early reading of a player the net was not trained on is what is new here. If the lane shows a loss against Gen 7.1's result on BEN, lower the factor before anything else.

Not preflighted: the preflight plays boards and a BEN board needs BEN's server. Prepare was checked (it accepts this plan from the capture capsule); the first boards on a machine with BEN are the check of the rest.
notes: docs/gen8_candidate_2026-11-12.md is the notice this file belongs to.

This is configs/round71-ben.json with 71s-32 replaced by 8s-32, the Gen 8 candidate of configs/round8-candidate.json: the same entry, so the same identity in both cohorts. BEN boards carry no audits (`ben_audit`) and no gap forks. A machine that plays one BEN level keeps one of the two pairs, as the Azure lanes do.

Systems: BEN declares `ben-gib-bbo-8742` (configs/systems; BEN's own two-over-one, as far as that package knows it). The system scorer holds no table for it, so BEN's calls are read by the base hand-fit scorer exactly as Gen 7.1 reads them, and the candidate's `lead_systems` names it, so the lead net is used at BEN tables as in Gen 7.1. What differs from Gen 7.1 at a BEN table is the play reading alone. Records are labelled `systems:house-gen6|ben-gib-bbo-8742` (or the reverse) in the own-auction rooms.
The collector plays BEN boards with one worker and stops on the first failed board, so each BEN pair needs its server up at the URL in the bot's spec.
Source run, as for Gen 7.1: a machine prepares from the drained cohort it is replacing or from the capture capsule with its own --shard K/N.
model_note: Gen 8 candidate (8s-32) is Gen 7.1 standard with the play read from trick 1 at exponent 1.0 (BEN's plays at 0.5), and with each side's calls read by the bidding system that side declares; BEN's calls and leads are read as Gen 7.1 reads them. BEN (64) and BEN (16) are the source run's. docs/gen8_candidate_2026-11-12.md has the details.
